topic: Pop-up gazebos, shade sails and bell tents
summary: A 10 by 10 ft (3.05 m) pop-up pavilion stands about 3.3 m at the peak (10 ft 9 in) with about 2.0 m of clear height at the entrance (6 ft 7 in). A standard equilateral shade sail has 16 ft (4.88 m) sides, so it is about 4.2 m deep; it hangs from three anchor posts or walls with tensioning hardware, and posts need proper footings (check with the venue). Bell tents run 4 to 6 m across on one center pole, 2.5 to 3.5 m high at the center; a 5 m tent stands about 3 m tall with a 1.75 m door and sleeps about four. Anything with stakes, ballast or weights, wind limits or sleeping needs a venue and fire marshal check: check with the venue and the fire marshal. Shade types for CATALOG: gazebo = roof, shade_sail = slats (open flat cloth), bell_tent = round.
